title: Chicken Dan Dan Noodles

items: 180 grams noodles, uncooked ( serving would be 60 grams per serving- this is a large serving )
1 bunch bokchoy \ spinach, any greens you can get work well here
1 tbsp each chopped ginger + chopped garlic

method: Add water to a pan, poach the bokchoy, remove then boil noodles and set aside

For the mince, add oil to a pan then add in the mince and let it cook down, you need to keep mashing it so it doesnt stay in big chunks then when its almost cooked add in the garlic and ginger, dark soy, oyster sauce, vinegar and salt + pepper
Stir together and then whack the flame up to cook on high heat till it dries out

For the sauce, in a bowl, add in garlic, chilli flakes, gochugara, sesame seeds and top with hot oil. leave for 15 seconds then add in soy, vinegar, peanut butter and jaggery and mix together to form the sauce
I like to lighten mine out and make it more liquid so i add in 2 - 3 tbsp vegetable stock
To plate, in a bowl, add in the sauce, then noodles, then mince, then bokchoy and garnish with a little sesame seeds
tips: Traditionally, this dish is made with schezuan peppercorns but i did not have them though this dish still tasted fantastic
In order to maximize nutrition, you can reduce noodles to 40 grams ( raw weight ) and use more chicken per portion
If you want the dish to be “saucier”, 1.5X the sauce recipe :) let me know if you need help with that, ill send it across!
caption:
Chicken Dan Dan Noodles
pantry basics | no fancy ingredients |  high protein 

Nutrition: 
C: 54 | F: 19 | P: 42
Calories: 554 per serve ( including noodles ) 
Makes 3 servings

Ingredients
180 grams noodles, uncooked ( serving would be 60 grams per serving- this is a large serving ) 
1 bunch bokchoy \ spinach, any greens you can get work well here

mince
450 grams chicken mince
1 tsp sesame oil
1 tbsp each chopped ginger + chopped garlic
1 tbsp soy sauce
1/2 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp vinegar
salt + pepper 

Sauce: 
5 cloves garlic, finely chopped
1 tbsp chilli flakes
1/2 tbsp gochugara
1 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp vegetable / canola oil
1 tbsp dark soy
1 tbsp vinegar
1 tbsp peanut butter
1/2 tbsp jaggery

Method
add water to a pan, poach the bokchoy, remove then boil noodles and set aside 

for the mince, add oil to a pan then add in the mince and let it cook down, you need to keep mashing it so it doesnt stay in big chunks then when its almost cooked add in the garlic and ginger, dark soy, oyster sauce, vinegar and salt + pepper
stir together and then whack the flame up to cook on high heat till it dries out 

for the sauce, in a bowl, add in garlic, chilli flakes, gochugara, sesame seeds and top with hot oil. leave for 15 seconds then add in soy, vinegar, peanut butter and jaggery and mix together to form the sauce
i like to lighten mine out and make it more liquid so i add in 2 - 3 tbsp vegetable stock 

to plate, in a bowl, add in the sauce, then noodles, then mince, then bokchoy and garnish with a little sesame seeds
enjoy :) 

Notes: 
traditionally, this dish is made with schezuan peppercorns but i did not have them though this dish still tasted fantastic 
in order to maximize nutrition, you can reduce noodles to 40 grams ( raw weight ) and use more chicken per portion
if you want the dish to be “saucier”, 1.5X the sauce recipe :) let me know if you need help with that, ill send it across!
